caption: The drawing features a single, large object placed centrally inside a rectangular border, resembling a wooden scoop or ladle with a wide, flat bowl and an angled handle. The scoop is rendered in shades of brown, with darker and lighter areas suggesting texture and grain variance typical of wood. There are two additional smaller rectangles within the main border: one in the upper right corner containing a line drawing of the object in profile showing its angled shape, and one in the lower left corner containing a line drawing from above showing the object’s outline with a rounded bowl and a straight handle. The background is a plain beige color with some signs of age, including yellowish discoloration and faint marks, especially along the right edge. The overall composition is simple, focusing on the central wooden object and its two outline views.
title: Square Wooden Spoon
